# Local study of the OPS Skills: generated tables

Generated by `npm run study:report` from the records under `results/runs/`. Protocol: [`../protocol.md`](../protocol.md). Amendments: [`../amendments.md`](../amendments.md).

**The study is not complete:** at least one required observation is missing, pending a rerun, or could not be scored. Nothing below is a final result.

## Admissible observations

Effective score out of 100 (raw score in brackets when a hard failure set the effective score to zero). A case passes at 80 or more without a hard failure. ↻ marks a corrective rerun: the case was executed again after its oracle was repaired. ⏱ marks a run stopped at its time limit.

| Case | Track | Kind | WITHOUT_SKILLS | INITIAL_SKILLS | Δ final − baseline |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| C1 Convert a fully specified prose request into an OPS prompt | authoring | development | 100 ↻ | not run | n/a |
| C2 Improve and convert a legacy, deficient prompt into the OPS contract | authoring | development | 100 | not run | n/a |
| C3 Plan a frozen OPS prompt for a nested workspace, plan only | execution | development | 90 ↻ | not run | n/a |
| C4 Execute a frozen OPS prompt against a deterministic bug | execution | development | 90 ↻ | not run | n/a |
| C5 Resume a frozen OPS prompt from a recorded checkpoint | execution | reserved regression | not run | not run | n/a |

Final candidate: `INITIAL_SKILLS`. No refinement was made.

## Attempts set aside

These attempts are kept and are not part of the comparison. "Original grade" is the grade under the oracle frozen before the run. "Diagnostic replay" is the same stored evidence scored with the repaired oracle; it is not an agent run and not an observation.

| Attempt | Original grade | Diagnostic replay | Why it is set aside |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `WITHOUT_SKILLS.c1-author-basic.a1` | 90 (failed C1-02) | 100 | The oracle of this case was repaired after this run (C1-02: the accepted wording of the rounding rule was broadened (changed accepted evidence)). |
| `WITHOUT_SKILLS.c3-plan-nested.a1` | 80 (failed C3-02, C3-06) | 100 | The oracle of this case was repaired after this run (C3-06: phrases are now matched across line breaks (grader implementation error); C3-02: a mention of the other package inside an out-of-scope statement is now accepted (changed accepted evidence)). |
| `WITHOUT_SKILLS.c4-execute-bugfix.a1` | 90 (failed C4-01) | 100 | The oracle of this case was repaired after this run (C4-01: the validator verdict is now read from its own output line instead of the exit status of the tool call (grader implementation error)). |
